criteria: The selected historical action and responsible actor have a sufficiently precise predecision event boundary; a clock minute is required only when material to receipt or intervention.

Material factual premises have primary-source support and exact external locators, or are explicitly qualified/unknown without contradicting the question being tested. Complete source dossiers or personal knowledge of every actor are not universally required.
Source publication, reconstructed earlier conditions and actual actor receipt are distinguished. Operational intervention and known feasibility need support at the applicable cutoff.
Later outcomes, legal amendments and stronger proposed safeguards are kept distinct from predecision historical design.
Every evaluator request/envelope respects masking and separation, while retaining selected actions, relevant power relationships and uncertainty.
Historical packs/trials and existing valid tests remain immutable; an integrity gate may fail when candidate sources intentionally diverge from the preserved historical pack.
